description: Lists the team's Content Autopilot tasks with status, schedule and next run. Use when the user asks which content automations exist, which are active, or wants a task ID. Not for social posting automations or run history (use list_autopilot_events). Returns tasks with ID, name, status, how they make content, repeat and next run, plus has_more.

content_type.description: What each run makes: workout = a single workout; program = a multi-week program.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

scope.description: How each run makes content: ai_generate = AI writes a new item from the task's rules; create_similar = AI writes a variation of source_content_id; publish_existing = makes existing_content_id visible to members (a scheduled release).

search.description: Text to search names for, e.g. "core". Omit to list everything.

sort_by.description: Sort field: updated_at = last changed; created_at = when made. Backend default: updated_at.

sort_order.description: Sort direction: asc = oldest first; desc = newest first. Backend default: desc.

status.description: active = runs on its schedule; draft = saved but not scheduled (new tasks start here).

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_autopilot_tasks
title: List content automations
